stem.text: Which pair of statements are correct?

A.text: Carbon and oxygen occur in a ratio of 2:1 in carbohydrates.

B.text: Glycolipids are found in all cell surface membranes.
Carbohydrates are stored as starch in plants.

C.text: Phospholipids all have two saturated hydrocarbon chains.

D.text: Water is released during the formation of a glycosidic bond.
Phospholipids all have three ester bonds.
